Generate Leakage-Free Patient-Level Train / Validation / Test Splits

Source: R/dl-prep.R
dicom_patient_splits.Rd

Partitions a cohort manifest data.frame or tibble::tibble into "train", "val", and "test" splits strictly grouped by patient_col so that all series and studies belonging to a patient remain in the same fold.

Usage

dicom_patient_splits(
  cohort,
  patient_col = "patient_id",
  val_frac = 0.15,
  test_frac = 0.15,
  seed = NULL
)

Arguments

cohort

A data.frame or tibble::tibble with one row per scan/series.

patient_col

Name of the patient identifier column. Default is "patient_id".

val_frac

Fraction of patients assigned to validation. Default is 0.15.

test_frac

Fraction of patients assigned to test. Default is 0.15.

seed

Optional integer random seed for reproducible splitting.

Value

The input cohort tibble with an added split character column ("train", "val", or "test").

Examples

df <- tibble::tibble(
  patient_id = rep(paste0("P", 1:10), each = 2L),
  series = seq_len(20L)
)
dicom_patient_splits(df, val_frac = 0.2, test_frac = 0.2, seed = 42L)
#> # A tibble: 20 × 3
#>    patient_id series split
#>    <chr>       <int> <chr>
#>  1 P1              1 val  
#>  2 P1              2 val  
#>  3 P2              3 train
#>  4 P2              4 train
#>  5 P3              5 train
#>  6 P3              6 train
#>  7 P4              7 train
#>  8 P4              8 train
#>  9 P5              9 val  
#> 10 P5             10 val  
#> 11 P6             11 train
#> 12 P6             12 train
#> 13 P7             13 train
#> 14 P7             14 train
#> 15 P8             15 test 
#> 16 P8             16 test 
#> 17 P9             17 train
#> 18 P9             18 train
#> 19 P10            19 test 
#> 20 P10            20 test
